subject: World Editor?
author: ZombieTron
body:
I don't think anyone knows yet, it might be worth emailing mailbag@criteriongames.com as they maybe willing to give more info about this now. 💻

The latest info we have about PC gaming mods is:

"Criterion Games has today announced that the award-winning Burnout Paradise is being rebuilt specifically for the PC. The game will be the first Burnout title ever made for the PC, offering expanded multiplayer, enhanced online features and community driven content."
 
But, Community Driven Content could mean anything???
